summary: Official warnings state that taking this drug with encorafenib can lead to new cancers, both on the skin and elsewhere in the body [3]. The drug also carries a warning for cardiomyopathy, which is a disease of the heart muscle [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this medicine a high liver score of 72 and a low heart score of 18 [M].
